One more thought before we (hopefully) receive another piece of correspondence. As a person commented below, 3301 has been very literal and direct with their clues. Perhaps when they say "Liber Primus is the way," they're talking about, quite literally, the liber primus: in Latin, "first book". The first book, or the oldest known story which could be called a book, is The Epic of Gilgamesh (or perhaps the first bound copies of the Bible/Gutenberg Bible). I've been trying vigenere cipher keywords (subbing V for U, etc.) and Caesar shifting them in every conceivable way, but no luck. The Epic of Gilgamesh has what I would consider...related themes, building off of the Koans and other pieces of advice handed down in their "Liber Primus". Of course it contributes nothing (that I know of) toward the symbols on Page 0. From wiki:
"The first half of the story discusses Gilgamesh, king of Uruk, and Enkidu, a wild man created by the gods to stop Gilgamesh from oppressing the people of Uruk. After an initial fight, Gilgamesh and Enkidu become close friends. Together, they journey to the Cedar Mountain and defeat Humbaba, its monstrous guardian. Later they kill the Bull of Heaven, which the goddess Ishtar sends to punish Gilgamesh for spurning her advances. As a punishment for these actions, the gods sentence Enkidu to death.
In the second half of the epic, distress about Enkidu's death causes Gilgamesh to undertake a long and perilous journey to discover the secret of eternal life. He eventually learns that 'Life, which you look for, you will never find. For when the gods created man, they let death be his share, and life withheld in their own hands.'"
I'm going to poke around that idea for a while - if anyone has already tried or mentioned it here, please let me know. Thanks!

revision.text:
Hey all,
I don't know if I've come across something, but for what it's worth, here are my two cents.
At first I took all the runes and translated them, as they appear in the Gematria Primus. Then through trial and error, I tried Rail Fence ciphers and even took each letter's totient value and found divisors for each number, picking out the primes from each one to see if that produced anything. Nothing. So I took the red runes at the top of Page 0 (just the rune-to-Gematria translation) and ran them through a Vigenère rune table which was uploaded by SepheusIX on this site. I used "INTUS" as the keyword (I believe the crosses on Page 0, 1, and 2 are direction signs, and "INTUS" is Latin for "Within" - if any direction we should be headed toward, it should be "within")... from that result I found their simple mirror letter(s) on the Reverse Gematria from last year (just find the letter on the left column and look to where it points on the right), then took that result and, using just the left side of the Reverse Gematria, counted each result letter's place in the modern alphabet down the Reverse Gematria that many numbers (and writing down the letters on both sides of the arrows, or both columns), doing this for each letter until I ended up with one final result. From that I could see "DARWIN THE DIABLO" or "DARWIN EL DIABLO". Here's what it looks like:
RUNES: S/Z--H--E--O--G-M-IA/IO-F S/Z-Y-E-IA/IO-C/K
KEY: I----N--T--U--S-I-N-----T U---S-I-N-----T---
----------------------------------------------------------
RESULT: C/K EA TH TH L N E P X J H E EA
MIRROR: D F Y Y H M I S/Z X B L I F
REV. GEM.: O/AE D/CK A/R A/R W/NG/ING T/EO H/L E/I D/C/K U/IA/IO J/B H/L C/K/D _ _ _ _ __ + / + / + * ** * * *O beginning?
As you can see, the different words are categorized by different symbols. I think the reason "O" looped back to the beginning is due to the infinity sign on each of these pages... Though I'm not sure how that will play out with the rest of the translation. In any case, this led me to a 2003 book published by one of my favorite authors: Richard Dawkins. A book called, A Devil's Chaplain. Interesting stuff in that book - many historical references in there, particularly Sanderson of Oundle.
Anyway, that's where I'm at. I could be completely wrong, but if anyone can shake out more info from that route, I think we'd all be grateful. I'll keep plugging away at it.
All the best.
-Birdie
